title: Hearty Roast Beef Sandwiches
description: Juicy roast beef, crispy onions, and melted cheddar cheese on a toasted sub roll. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Season the roast beef with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the roast beef until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the roast beef to the preheated oven and roast for 2-3 hours, or until tender and reach an internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
While the roast beef is cooking, caramelize the onions in a large skillet over medium-low heat.
Once the roast beef is cooked, let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain.
Assemble the sandwiches by spreading a layer of caramelized onions on the sub rolls, followed by sliced roast beef, and topped with shredded cheddar cheese.
Place the sandwiches under the broiler for a few minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
